svg.aria-label: Token architecture drawing sheet: token pipeline from Git to components, the four token tiers, an alias chain from a button token to its value, token name anatomy, CSS scope cascade, runtime guards, brand override boundaries and tables
svg.text: FOUR TIERS ALIAS DOWNWARD: T3 → T2 → T1.
BRAND FILES RESOLVE EVERY TOKEN FOR ONE BRAND.
ONE BUILD WRITES BRANDS.TS AND TOKENS.CSS.
THE RUNTIME SCOPES VARS; NEAREST SCOPE WINS.
GUARDS RUN AFTER THE BRAND IS APPLIED.
Git → build → generated data → runtime scope → Tailwind and component CSS → components
Each tier aliases the one below · brand files are resolved
Default chain to #1C1C1C; Cosmopolitan’s brand file resolves the same name to #D70000
One name, six parts · states default · hover · active · disabled
The nearest scope that defines a var wins
CTA COLOR, ELSE THE TEXT COLOR
theme-css-vars.ts · tested across all 36 themes in light and dark
